summary: BI-D8101329 (MCP tool-tier Phase 2). Add McpToolSession, a per-token short-TTL store of which extra MCP tool names a token pulled into scope via load_tools, so tools/list can append them to the lean core tier (append-not-swap). Discovery-only state with no authorization meaning — tools/call still gates on grants. No PII: the row is keyed by an opaque MCP token id (not a person) and holds tool names + TTL timestamps. Additive, non-destructive: a new table only, no changes to existing rows, applies cleanly against any existing data state. Rows are removed by their own expiresAt sweep (sweepExpiredToolSessions + lazy delete on read), so the model is retention-exempt as domain-lifecycle-managed. Migration: 20260808000000_add_mcp_tool_session.

fields.name: tokenId
fields.reason: Opaque MCP token id (PAT id or session id). Scopes the deferred-tool session, not a person; no data subject to locate or mask.
fields.provenance: Derived from the authenticated MCP token on the tools/call load_tools request; no external source.

fields.name: loadedToolNames
fields.reason: The tool names this token loaded into discovery scope. Platform tool identifiers, not tenant or personal data.
fields.provenance: Set by load_tools from the token's own grant-filtered tool surface.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.reason: Short TTL after which the session reads as empty and is swept. Operational timestamp.
